page.content:
Remote pantheon that wrote the rules of Mortal Kombat.

How Elder Gods connects

  • Event: Mortal Kombat tournament — The Elder Gods wrote the rules of the Mortal Kombat tournament.
  • Character: Raiden — Raiden answers to the Elder Gods while bending their rules for Earthrealm.

What is Elder Gods?

The Elder Gods set the tournament laws that keep realms from merging at will. Raiden answers to them, and they punish emperors who skip the rules.

Key threads lead to Mortal Kombat tournament and Raiden.
